channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Isiah Thomas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Isiah Thomas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Becky Hammon on Isiah Thomas, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Madeline Kenney:Becky Hammon on Jalen Brunson leading the Knicks to a championship:

“Jalen, all he did was prove history wrong, he proves he's an outlier, so you can put his name next to Steph Curry and Isiah Thomas,and I thought he played brilliantly, especially down the stretch. I mean, he was that 1A dude, but like, apologize, I'm never gonna apologize for having an opinion, that's what ESPN pays me for.”

Becky Hammon on Isiah Thomas, Jalen Brunson, Jun 23, 2026. Source: Twitter @madkenney.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
“I was laughing this morning, like, I didn't know if I could fit with Isiah (Thomas) or not, but I knew we both had great IQs and we'd figure it out,”

Joe Dumars on Isiah Thomas, Apr 14, 2026. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Isiah Thomas, Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan, Larry Bird
item.description:
Jayson Tatum:

“Isiah Thomas didn't win Finals MVP every time. Tim Duncan didn't win Finals MVP every time. Larry Bird. Steph Curry only has one. Kobe won two out of five championships. As a competitor, you want to win and accomplish everything in front of you, absolutely. But I would not be the slightest bit sad, you know, that I didn't win Finals MVP. I would be ecstatic just to win the Finals.”

Jayson Tatum on Isiah Thomas, Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan, Larry Bird, Jun 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas
item.description:
ClutchPoints:Gilbert Arenas:

“Isiah [Thomas] lost, [Michael] Jordan, as a friend to [him], was like, ‘I want the same respect’ & the fact that Isiah walked off [He] took it personally.”

Gilbert Arenas on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas, Mar 20, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas, Charles Barkley, Joe Dumars, Patrick Ewing, Larry Bird, Robert Parish
item.description:
Miller was a five-time All-Star, with his first All-Star selection coming in 1990 in Miami in just his third NBA season.

“I remember in 1990 walking into the locker room for the first time, and there's Larry (Bird) and there's Isiah (Thomas) and there was Jordan and there was Joe Dumars and there was Robert Parish, there was Charles (Barkley), Patrick (Ewing),”

Reggie Miller on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas, Charles Barkley, Joe Dumars, Patrick Ewing, Larry Bird, Robert Parish, Feb 16, 2024. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: John Salley on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas
item.description:
John Salley on why he thinks that Isiah Thomas is so disrespected by so many people in the league:

“Because it was a false narrative. Isiah took the fall when they said that he didn’t want to give the ball to Michael [Jordan],which when you’re watching that game he gave the ball to Michael the whole time. Michael and I had the same agent and at times he wanted me not to like Isiah. That was his personal thing. But there’s no reason for it to be like that. I just don’t understand because he is really a good guy.”

John Salley on Michael Jordan, Isiah Thomas, Aug 29, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tim Hardaway on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
Hardaway said of his decision, per Ira Winderman.

“Isiah Thomas, I grew up watching him play, my basketball idol, no question, from the city of Chicago,”

Tim Hardaway on Isiah Thomas, Sep 8, 2022. Source: SLAM.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
“He played it differently. But I put Steph right up there with Isiah Thomas as the best little guards to ever play the game.”

Charles Barkley on Isiah Thomas, Jul 28, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
But after acknowledging Stephen Curry was the primary force behind four Warriors championships in an eight-year span, Charles served up a rather provocative comparison.

“I said after he won this one, that puts him on the list with Isiah Thomas,”

Charles Barkley on Isiah Thomas, Jul 28, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Rod Thorn, Isiah Thomas
item.description:
McCallum said Jordan brought up the issue of Thomas himself in a 2011 interview.

“When they called me and asked me to play — Rod Thorn called me. I said ‘Rod, I won’t play if Isiah Thomas is on the team.’ He assured me. He said, ‘Chuck doesn’t want Isiah. So, Isiah is not going to be part of the team,’”

Michael Jordan on Rod Thorn, Isiah Thomas, May 26, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: David Robinson on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
David Robinson on Isiah Thomas:

“If you have a reputation and you take pride in your reputation as a ‘Bad Boy’ it kind of means people aren’t going to like you. Can you be that surprised when people say ‘I don’t really want to play with the ‘Bad Boys?’”

David Robinson on Isiah Thomas, May 11, 2020. Source: reddit.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Isiah Thomas, Magic Johnson
item.description:
“To me, if the best point guard of all time is Magic Johnson, and right behind him is Isiah Thomas. No matter how much I hate him, I respect his game.”

Michael Jordan on Isiah Thomas, Magic Johnson, May 4, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
Wade, on where he ranks in rich Chicago-born players history:

“I have no idea. When people have asked me who I think the best player who was born and raised in Chicago, I always go with Isiah Thomas.”

Dwyane Wade on Isiah Thomas, Jan 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
Charles Barkley on Pistons front office:

“I would like for the Pistons to consider bringing in Isiah Thomas as the president of basketball operations.”

Charles Barkley on Isiah Thomas, May 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Adam Silver on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
“I think no, it’s not great to see and hear those issues being rehashed, but I think specifically in the case of Isiah Thomas, and I’ll focus on him, because he’s actively involved in the Liberty and WNBA right now … for our fans, for people who follow the industry, I think it’s important that you represent yourself publicly,”

Adam Silver on Isiah Thomas, Oct 23, 2015. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Larry Brown on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
Adam Zagoria:Larry Brown:

“I'm not a big Isiah Thomas fan but he's brilliant. I know he wants to get back into the NBA.”

Larry Brown on Isiah Thomas, Jun 1, 2015. Source: Twitter @AdamZagoria.

item.title: Larry Brown on Isiah Thomas, Stephon Marbury
item.description:
“Marbury was not our problem. That’s not fair. Isiah (Thomas) and Marbury were a problem because Marbury and Isiah were connected at the hip, and there was no chance for Stephon to be able to play for me. But he was a good kid and had really no chance (of) being successful the way the dynamics worked out. A coach needs to be able to coach a team and needs the president, the owner, the GM – everybody – to be on the same page. Jim Dolan gave me every chance to be successful, but we didn’t have any unity in the way that program was run. And as a result, it struggled. “If you look at the great NBA franchises,”

Larry Brown on Isiah Thomas, Stephon Marbury, Mar 3, 2015. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Donnie Walsh on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
A source said one name that won't be considered is Isiah Thomas , though incessant reports about his continued relationship with Dolan was something Walsh admitted was an issue.

“I don't think Isiah Thomas had anything to do with anything I'm doing now,”

Donnie Walsh on Isiah Thomas, Jun 3, 2011. Source: Newsday.

item.title: James Dolan on Isiah Thomas
item.description:
Thomas was asked point-blank by radio host Sid Rosenberg if he's advising Dolan, specifically on Anthony.

“The conversations I have with any of my friends are always private and confidential,'' Thomas said.”

James Dolan on Isiah Thomas, Feb 16, 2011. Source: New York Post.
